first_week_selection.method: Python random.Random(seed).choice over chronologically sorted eligible unused UTC Mondays

TREND_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION.cause: an established one-hour price-discovery move retains open-interest inventory while a controlled fifteen-minute counter-move is rejected by renewed aggressive flow
TREND_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION.entry_sequence: prior one-hour trend -> completed pullback -> completed five-minute reacceleration -> next one-minute execution
TREND_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION.invalidation: beyond the observed pullback extreme plus ATR buffer
TREND_PULLBACK_REACCELERATION.target: retest and extension beyond the prior one-hour external extreme

TREND_TERMINAL_SWEEP_REVERSAL.cause: an extreme one-hour move enters toxic or closing-inventory conditions, sweeps the external extreme and fails back inside
TREND_TERMINAL_SWEEP_REVERSAL.entry_sequence: extreme one-hour trend -> external sweep -> close back inside with opposite flow and depth -> next one-minute execution
TREND_TERMINAL_SWEEP_REVERSAL.invalidation: beyond the sweep extreme plus ATR buffer

LOW_TOXICITY_AUCTION_ROTATION.cause: a low-efficiency, low-VPIN, stable-OI auction rejects a one-sided value excursion and rotates through value
LOW_TOXICITY_AUCTION_ROTATION.entry_sequence: balanced one-hour auction -> previous value excursion -> completed return toward center with supportive depth -> next one-minute execution
LOW_TOXICITY_AUCTION_ROTATION.invalidation: two-standard-deviation price discovery beyond frozen value

COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_RETEST.cause: open interest accumulates in a compressed auction, a displacement bar discovers price outside the frozen boundary, and the boundary holds on retest
COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_RETEST.entry_sequence: completed compression -> completed displacement breakout -> completed retest and reacceleration -> next one-minute execution
COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_RETEST.invalidation: back inside the frozen boundary plus ATR buffer

LIQUIDATION_DISTORTION_RECLAIM.cause: a high-displacement fifteen-minute move is accompanied by falling OI, then aggressive flow and depth reverse as forced inventory is exhausted
LIQUIDATION_DISTORTION_RECLAIM.entry_sequence: OI-decreasing displacement -> completed midpoint reclaim -> opposite flow and depth -> next one-minute execution
LIQUIDATION_DISTORTION_RECLAIM.invalidation: beyond the liquidation impulse extreme plus ATR buffer

common_execution.risk: 3% of current NautilusTrader NAV by expected stop loss including fees, slippage, impact and funding allowance

promotion_rule: Only a scenario passing every criterion in the locked first-week NautilusTrader run may be frozen and advanced to a prospectively selected second week.
